caseName: Northwest Airlines, Inc. v. County of Kent
caseNameFull: Northwest Airlines, Inc. v. County of Kent, Michigan

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 508 U. S. 959.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
